title: Metaplanet denies selling bitcoin worth $320 million
summary: Metaplanet CEO dismisses bitcoin sale rumors, confirms 43,000 BTC holdings

title: Bitcoin firms ask AI labs for same tools attackers already have
summary: Coinbase, Block, BitGo and dozens of others signed a letter arguing that safety guardrails on frontier models are blocking legitimate security work while adversaries face no such limits.

title: Speculation on dogecoin is back to October 2025 levels. The price is down 70%
summary: Futures positioning has rebuilt to levels last seen when dogecoin traded at three times today's price, and more than three accounts are betting on a rebound for every one betting against.

title: Bitcoin slips near $63,500 as traders look past CPI to Fed’s next tests
summary: An in-line inflation print removed a tail risk but gave BTC little reason to rally, leaving Jackson Hole, jobs data and the next CPI release as the market’s next catalysts.

title: Prediction markets should dial back faulty filings for incentives to boost trading: CFTC
summary: The U.S. regulator of platforms such as Kalshi and Polymarket suggests the industry is getting into bad compliance habits that may allow for market abuse.
